BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP/2025)
CLASS:  BBA   SEMESTER : VI
BRANCH: MANAGEMENT   SESSION : SP/2025

SUBJECT: MT335 MARKETING ANALYTICS
TIME:   02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   CO BL
Q.1 Define clearly the term ‘Marketing Analytics’ and explain its role in making marketing
decisions. Give suitable examples to support your answer
[5] 1,2 1,2


Q.2 Briefly  explain  the  concepts  of  ‘Scales’  and  ‘Scaling’  in  marketing  research  and
discuss  the  scales  that  you  will  employ  to  carry  out  a  market  survey  related  to
estimating  the  level  of  satisfaction  of  customers  towards  a  newly  launched  smart
phone.
[5] 2,3 2,3


Q.3 Analyse the concept of price bundling and discuss its practical applications in today's
digital  marketplace.  Provide  examples  of  companies  effectively  utilizing  price
bundling strategies.
[5] 3,4 2,3,4


Q.4  Explain the steps involved in Demand Curve Estimation. Discuss how understanding
demand elasticity can influence pricing strategies.
[5] 2,3,4 3,4,5


Q.5 What  is  predictive  analytics  in  marketing?  Provide  examples  to  illustrate  the
importance  of  predictive  analytics  in  context  of  decision  making  and  supporting
various management functions.
[5] 4,5 3,4,5
